subject: Cohort onboarding
body:
Pack handover to Programs

Equipment wording corrected; plain link added below the setup button; contact block checked on a narrow screen. The green-underlined cover is the reviewed copy. Older forwarded packs may still contain the image-only button.

The bottle reminder belongs above the footer in the print version. Omar caught the overlap; please use print preview before producing a fresh stack.

Individual accessibility questions should go directly to the contact rather than reply-all. I've kept those conversations out of the group thread. Yara is using the corrected pack at the welcome desk. Nora

Maja now has the staff contact list for her induction pack. I've replaced its student-menu link, so the next new colleague won't have to ask which welcome pack was meant for them.
title: Cohort onboarding
